verdict.rationale: The official README explicitly lists generating new apps from PDFs, images, or sketches using Gemini's multimodal capabilities as a core use case, which matches the story directly. The community complaints about general agentic reliability are not specifically about multimodal app generation, so they don't create a dispute. missing for 10: in-depth docs or a walkthrough of the image/PDF-to-app workflow, evidence that the generated apps actually work, independent or hands-on corroboration of this feature.
